description: MANDATE-15 ca 'ban chu khong hong', ban cho EKS. Tao tai HOP LE that su bang cach nhan ban chinh load-generator cua he (khong co flag loi nao dinh vao) roi xac nhan detector KHONG keu oan. PASS = khong rule nao trong monitored_rule_ids ban trong cua so. Day la nua con lai cua cau hoi ma ca quiet-window khong tra loi duoc: quiet-window chi hoi 'binh thuong co keu nham khong', ca nay hoi 'BAN co bi nham la HONG khong'.
notes: BAN COMPOSE CU chay locust tu may ca nhan. Khong dung tren EKS: locust keo theo locust-plugins[playwright] (tai ca trinh duyet), locustfile.py:78 goi flagd OFREP luc khoi dong ma flagd khong voi toi tu may ngoai, va can LOCUST_HOST cong khai.

LAN CHAY DAU dung `kubectl scale deploy/load-generator --replicas=4`. Chay duoc nhung TAI TANG QUA IT: do duoc chi 1.47 lan so voi nen (24.69 -> dinh 36.38 req/s). PASS tren tai 1.47x khong thuyet phuc cho cau hoi 'ban co bi nham la hong khong' — 1.47x chua that su la 'ban'.

BAN NAY dung REST API cua locust (LOCUST_WEB_PORT=8089, LOCUST_HEADLESS=false nen web UI song). POST /swarm doi so user NGAY, KHONG restart pod. Do duoc: 22 -> 106 user cho thong luong 24.69 -> 94.80 req/s, tuc 3.84 LAN. Bo nho chi 100 -> 103 MiB tren limit 512Mi, con nhieu du dia.

CHON REST API thay vi nhan ban pod vi hai le: (1) nhan ban chi cho 1.47x do pod moi can thoi gian ramp user; (2) `kubectl scale` va `kubectl set env` deu gay nhip traffic tut luc pod len/xuong, ma nhip tut do co the tu no lam service-traffic-collapse keu — tao dung mot bao dong gia tren chinh ca dung de chung minh khong co bao dong gia.
off tra ve 22 user = dung muc nen luc bat dau do (khong phai 10 nhu LOCUST_USERS trong values.yaml — muc thuc te tren cum la 22).
monitored_rule_ids liet ke du 14 rule dang co trong rules.yaml, gom ca service-traffic-collapse va latency-p95-high — tai cao lam tang latency nen day la rule dang theo doi nhat.
duration 420s de tai cao phu tron mot cua so rate(...[5m]) va con du bien; settle 180s de alert cham (neu co) van kip roi vao cua so cham diem.
